method: Official release notes and changelog pages only; no product was installed or run.

products.name: 聲嶼 Elitesand Pro
changesSincePreviousRound: Single-song OBS setlist board with user-written idle text, ten looks
Outro pause auto-finish: pausing for N seconds after the last line ends the song (off or 3-30 s, default 8)
Import Kugou .krc, KRC text and word-timed LRC with per-word timing
Korean romanization follows actual pronunciation (liaison, nasalization)
Separate accompaniment and vocal volume when vocal separation is on
Lyric cleanup of credits, section headers and subtitle position codes; [offset:] applied to OBS
Simplified/Traditional Chinese treated as the same song for search and dedupe
PIN attempt limit shared across entry points; downloaded tools verified by signature and hash

items: Better quality and track sync for large key shifts (about ±4 and beyond)
Apple Music lyrics falls back to another source when unreachable
EULA 2.3.0 adds lyric-source category codes to community offset requests

limitations: Anonymous statistics and community offsets default on; disclosed, not network-audited

products.name: 歌回救星 Singing Stream Savior
changesSincePreviousRound: Restore a backed-up streamer identity for audience requests after reinstall or a new PC
Manual audio diagnostics record more detail when a monitor device switch fails
Official user Discord opened

items: Signal Veil/Tide switch between waveform and spectrum
Launcher recovers when no beta exists and starts the installed version offline; repair entry added

Default theme can hide section titles for custom backgrounds
OBS setlist scrolling resumes after the source is hidden and shown again

products.name: KAREOKIE
changesSincePreviousRound: Version jumped from 0.3.6 to 4.1.0; V4 layout is standard
YouTube stage: app finds lyrics, times them to the video and adds scoring and pitch lane; timing shared after the first singer
Shared song library of about 28,000 songs; translations and readings for about 25,000 songs prepared server-side, human before AI
Optional live vocal removal on the PC, key -6 to +6, guide vocal slider
Duets by part with per-mic scoring; levels, titles and 14-day leaderboards
Account sync for playlists, favourites and history
4.4 restores local download mode with on-PC separation alongside YouTube mode
4.4 first-song help: mic check by singing a note, readiness of lyrics/timing/melody, clipping notice on results, vocal range test
Terms of Service v6 and Privacy Policy v10; analysis from eligible older-library songs shared by default
limitations: Account and cloud dependency deeper than previous round; disclosed, not network-audited
